limitations: Applies only to iid binary marks with conditional exponential durations and ordinary first-trial initialization; the existence of a crossing does not imply uniqueness; generic renewal-count literature may imply the result implicitly.
scientific_integrity: Exact marked-renewal identity and pole-based asymptotic signs for two-outcome conditional-exponential completion counts; no fabricated finite-budget uniqueness or unrestricted protocol generalization.
title: A covariance sign reversal between fast and slow absorbing-trajectory counts
